title: The microfilm reel, boxed
logline: The microfilm reel back in its small box on the shelf, the box's label typed with the Newport paper's name and 1999–2003, and a tiny pencilled gull on the box's end. Someone drew the mark on the archive. Not him.

panels.composition: A small microfilm box on a metal shelf with a typed label and a tiny pencilled gull mark on its end, other boxes beside it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small microfilm box on a metal shelf with a typed label and a tiny pencilled two-stroke gull mark on its end, other boxes beside it, no words legible
image.notes: Who drew it: reserved. Compare ro_2022-05-08.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
